conceptual_change: Shift from aggressive sweep-confirmation momentum-chasing to a mean-reversion retest model that filters out low-volatility liquidity sweeps.
rationale: The failure of sweep_confirmation suggests that validating liquidity sweeps in high-volatility regimes without checking for price exhaustion leads to false entries. Applying a quiet_retest logic ensures the entry only occurs after a liquidity sweep is followed by a localized volatility compression, preventing premature validation.
